selection: state VA; class_name General Purpose; county or municipal classification. Cities occur only in the municipal group, not twice as county equivalents.
measure: Authorities with at least one archived primary-source review, against the Census 2022 government roster plus VDOT. Not ordinance, permit-history, route or current-government completeness.
limitations: Road, easement and pole ownership are not established by a government roster.
Local government coverage includes county-owned property and franchises even where VDOT maintains roads.
Federal agencies, private owners, railroads and utilities are outside this baseline.
Roster vintage is 2022; later incorporations or dissolutions have not been reconciled.
